meaning.en: Manage conversations are private to an actor within a currently authorized project, separate from personal Ask and Code/Design conversations.
meaning.fa: گفت‌وگوهای مدیریت برای هر کاربر در پروژه مجاز جاری خصوصی هستند و از گفت‌وگوهای شخصی و کدنویسی و طراحی جدا می‌مانند.

authority.conversation_owner: Agentic for these IDE-backed conversations; this does not transfer a Chat-owned conversation.
authority.project_scope: Stable project UUID plus current slug and active_agent_slug=manage; no user-supplied project or service grants.
authority.permissions: Current project.settings.manage for every access. Creation additionally agents.run. Execution retains normal agents.run/billing.spend/model policy.
authority.manage_session: Current signed authority is rechecked before proxy. x-infera-project restricts all thread/review operations; it never grants membership.
authority.identity: Actor is signed session sub, normal Agentic gateway identity enforced again. organization/identity authority remains independently checked.

inputs.unknown_fields: 422; forged project/agent fields are not accepted as creation inputs

operations.output: Raw ChatThreadView object, UUID identifiers and RFC3339 timestamps; project_id nonnull and ide_mode code for this operation. Summary/runtime fields are not returned.
operations.side_effects: Insert one owner/project-bound IDE thread. No model request or charge.
operations.idempotency: No idempotency key; retries may create multiple threads. UI must prevent duplicate submits and reconcile uncertainty rather than claim exactly-once.

filters.fixed: owner_user_id=current actor AND project_id=authorized UUID AND project_slug=current slug AND active_agent_slug=manage
filters.search: Not supported by this route. Unknown query fields are currently ignored, not applied.
filters.limit: Optional unsigned integer1..100; default20. Noninteger/negative extractor errors, out-of-range400.
filters.before: Optional base64url-no-pad JSON cursor {at:UTC timestamp,id:UUID}; max256bytes. Invalid400. No lookup of cursor record required.
filters.sort: updated_at DESC, id DESC. Cursor selects older timestamp OR same timestamp with smaller BSON UUID. Concurrently updated rows may move to newer pages; this is not a snapshot.

operations.output: Raw array, not personal ChatThreadPage. x-has-more true/false; x-next-before only when more rows. Summary projected out.
operations.sdk: listAgentThreads first page; listAgentThreadsPage({limit,before}) preserves Axios headers.

lifecycle.read_delete_cancel_stream_review: Current project and owner checked before operation; personal/foreign/other-agent thread IDs404.
lifecycle.stream_preferences: Manage server binds manage/project/surface; strict context preferences accept four helper names and en/fa locale. Browser service list is replaced by current signed grants, then checked against current project configuration by Agentic. Trusted Chat source/assistant data is rejected.
lifecycle.deletion: Existing Agentic delete behavior applies; this test does not prove Knowledge forgetting, derived-source purge or durable review cancellation.
lifecycle.review: Existing in-memory pending hubs remain; no durable/idempotent execution-receipt claim.
lifecycle.outage: Current authority unavailable fails closed; no fallback to stale service grants. No model provider outage/canary claim.

relationships.label: project name/slug through current authorized project metadata
relationships.cross_project_navigation: New current signed authority required for a different project.

relationships.cardinality: one owner; not shared project history
relationships.lookup: Current authenticated identity, no arbitrary directory request.

remaining: Fresh canonical/main integration with other contributions
Paged and readable localized UI workflows
Durable review/receipt and thread deletion/forgetting workflows
Every other capability and cross-service workflow before publication
